title: Displaced Syabrubesi residents seek a way home after Bhotekoshi floods
body: Aerial view of Syabrubesi after the Bhotekoshi flood. Kathmandu, October 1 It has been more than a month since Singi Dhindup Tamang, 58, of Syabrubesi in Gosainkunda Rural Municipality-5, Rasuwa, arrived at Yellow Gumba in Swayambhu,…
